securityDebt: Monolithic server.ts (5,584 lines) co-locating public APIs, admin operations, VPS triggers, and webhooks
Direct VPS management endpoints (/api/admin/vps, vpsDiagnosticBridge.ts) requiring strict execution policies
Fallback dbStore.ts (177 KB) operating alongside Prisma with risk of split-brain or authorization bypass
Inconsistent authorization enforcement (mixture of direct Prisma queries and service layer checks)
Webhook endpoints requiring unified cryptographic HMAC signature verification and replay prevention
architecturalDebt: Vite SPA + Express monolith serving both client assets and backend API on a single port
Custom history-state router in App.tsx without modern file-based routing or SSR
Tight coupling of Synthesis Core (CMS, RBAC, Control Plane) and Tata ma pravo domain (OSPOD, courts, cases)
Hardcoded user-facing texts scattered across TSX components instead of unified CMS Text Registry
migrationRisks: Monolithic schema migration risk: migrating 139 models simultaneously into a clean modular monorepo
Data divergence risk between VPS PostgreSQL and client offline IndexedDB caches
Decoupling Synthesis OS/CMS from TMPR domain requires clean API and DB boundaries
Sensitive data handling: PII and child custody records require strict zero-trust gates prior to data migration
